
This is a list of [[IMAX Wiki|IMAX]] venues which feature either [[IMAX with Laser]] 4K projectors and/or [[70 mm film#IMAX%20(15/70)|15/70 mm]] film projectors. Not included are theatres with solely [[2K resolution]] digital [[Xenon arc lamp|xenon]] projectors.

IMAX with Laser locations use one of four types of 4K projector:

* GT Laser: Dual projector system capable of up to 1.43:1 aspect ratio.
* CoLa: Single projector, limited to 1.90:1 aspect ratio.
* XT: Single projector, limited to 1.90:1 aspect ratio.
* Dome Laser: Single projector. Used in dome theatres.

Traditional 15/70 mm IMAX locations use [[70 mm film]] projectors, with the film running through the projector(s) horizontally, each frame being 15 [[Film perforations|perforations]] wide. 3D presentations are shown using two projectors and either [[linear polarized]] or [[Active shutter 3D system|LCD shutter]] glasses. These locations are capable of displaying [[aspect ratios]] of up to 1.43:1.

IMAX 15/70 mm locations use one of five types of film projectors:

* GT: IMAX 15/70 mm 2D film projector.
* GT3D: IMAX 15/70 mm 3D film projector, dual rotor.
* SR: IMAX 15/70 mm 3D film projector, small rotor.
* GT Dome: IMAX 15/70 mm 2D dome film projector.
* SR Dome: IMAX 15/70 mm 2D dome film projector, small rotor.

Some theatres with legacy 1.43:1 screens have single laser projectors or digital projectors; these installations are restricted to projecting at a maximum of 1.90:1.

Dome theatres may indicate one or two screen sizes. The first (or only) number indicates the screen diameter. The second number (if present) indicates the screen surface width.
